turns.q: How long does it normally take to ship and send a tracking number?
turns.replyTail:
to be fulfilled, and tracking is typically sent once the order ships. After that, standard shipping usually takes another 4–8 business days.

If your order is personalized, the total timeline is usually 10–16 business days.

turns.q: Is there any way to speed it up if I need it sooner?
turns.replyTail:
to speed it up if I need it sooner?

I totally get wanting your order to arrive as soon as possible! Right now, we don’t offer expedited shipping—orders ship with standard delivery, which takes 4–8 business days once it leaves our warehouse. The good news is, most orders arrive on the earlier side of that window since our team works quickly. 😊

You can find all the details here: https://www.simplemodern.com/pages/shipping
